text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":12,"unit":"cats","kind":"count","span":"sold 12 siamese cats"},{"id":"q2","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"ratio of siamese cats to house cats sold was 2:1 (siamese part)"},{"id":"q3","value":1,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"ratio of siamese cats to house cats sold was 2:1 (house cats part)"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"siamese cats divided by their ratio part gives the value of one ratio unit"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"one ratio unit times house cats' ratio part gives house cats sold"},{"op":"add","args":["q1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"siamese cats plus house cats gives the combined total"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"combined number of cats sold (siamese plus house cats)"},"dismissed":[]}
